results.title: Detected categories show an AI-generated badge and a translation per market language

steps.expected: Discover Categories is enabled

steps.title: When the user clicks Discover Categories and discovery ends
steps.expected: The Categories step lists the detected categories as a flat list

steps.title: Then each detected category shows an "AI generated" badge
steps.expected: Every detected row carries the "AI generated" badge

steps.title: And each category shows its translation per market language without being opened
steps.expected: The row title is the English name, followed by "EN · FR (…) · ES (…)" with the French and Spanish names, a pencil and a cross

results.notes: Decathlon (decathlon.com), United Kingdom - English (EN), France - French (FR), Spain - Spanish (ES); Discover Categories enabled. Discovery returned a flat list of 2 categories: "Outdoor Gear" - AI generated - "EN · FR (Équipement de plein air) · ES (Equipo para exteriores)"; "Sports Apparel" - AI generated - "EN · FR (Vêtements de sport) · ES (Ropa deportiva)". Each row has "Edit {name}" (pencil) and "Delete {name}" (cross). Helper text: "We suggest 2 categories to start with...".

steps.expected: The Prompts step shows one table with every prompt

steps.expected: 10 Visibility, 10 Competitive and 10 Reputation prompts for C1 in GB (EN)

steps.title: And every suggestion is ticked
steps.expected: "40 selected" (30 for C1 + 10 Brand Image); no greyed row

steps.title: And each prompt carries the category and type that produced it
steps.expected: Each C1 row shows Category C1 and its type badge

results.notes: Test data adapted (one wizard session for the whole smoke): scope = GB (EN) + FR (FR), 2 categories kept (C1 Outdoor Gear, C2 Sports Apparel) = 140 suggestions instead of the minimal 40. Counts read on the table (one table, 140 rows): C1 Outdoor Gear in GB (EN): 10 Visibility, 10 Competitive, 10 Reputation (same for C2 and for FR (FR)); Overview / Brand Image: 10 per market. All 140 rows ticked ("Keep this prompt" checked), no greyed row (opacity 1); ring "399 / 24400 prompts · 140 selected" (= 259 + 140). Each row shows its category and its type badge. Generic prompt wording observed (e.g. "Best Outdoor Gear?", "Decathlon reviews?") - adapt-batch templates, not an AC point.

Header menus: "Sort and filter Category", "Sort and filter Type", "Sort and filter Country", plus "Show prompts". Ring "259 / 24400 prompts · 49 selected" (64 rows); popover: "Prompt pool 259 of 24400 / In use by other analyses 210 / Kept in this analysis 49 / Free in the pool 24141". Banner "4 prompts are in Other." (custom prompts of that analysis). Nothing ticked/unticked, nothing saved.
